questions: Can a characterization corpus cover verify_post_anchor completely enough to prove a refactor preserves behaviour?
Where are the natural seams, and does splitting there put each refuted design in one place?
Do any corpus fixtures collide, and does a collision mean the corpus is redundant or that a defect exists?

findings.statement: A twelve-fixture corpus plus a pinned-boundary call and the live ledger covers 51 of 51 executable statements in lines 615-725 with none missed
Four contiguous concerns separate at existing boundaries: classification 648-679, boundary resolution 681-684, entry reporting 686-697 and duplicate reporting 699-716, summary 718-725
Two fixture pairs produce byte-identical output; empty vs unlabeled is the concealment recorded at entry #742 and placeholder vs nonhex is the discarded field name recorded at entry #741
verify_post_anchor spans 615-725, 111 lines against a 40-line limit, AST-resolved; the largest proposed helper is 32 body lines
